evidence.quote: The Intercom MCP server is available for US and EU hosted workspaces.
Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
The Intercom MCP Server provides 16 tools for interacting with the Intercom API.
OAuth is for if you're building a public app that accesses other people's Intercom data.

review.reason: Intercom getting-started guide: development workspaces are free and can be created without limit; public apps use OAuth.
Free development workspace plus OAuth/access-token REST API follows build_now; AU-hosted workspaces lack MCP only.
The paid-plan gate was based on the missing free-workspace page; no review requirement found in the docs read.

Independent browser check disagreed; a blind browser ruling backed it. Intercom offers OAuth and a user-generated Access Token (personal token, api_key); judged against the field definition. Moderate confidence.
